definitions.ask: During install-all, should plugin-sync diffs go to the step log instead of the terminal?
definitions.why: Diffs run up to 60 lines per file and the digest already says what changed

choices.label: Terminal shows one row per changed plugin plus warnings; diffs go to the log; -v shows all
Today's raw sync output with diffs; one plugin update can scroll the digest away

definitions.ask: How should the digest render a commit body's trailing "Verified:" paragraph?
definitions.why: Verification is provenance, not news; one row proves it and the text is one git log away

choices.label: One dim row cut with …; saves 2-3 rows per commit so full messages fit more often
The whole paragraph in dim text, as the research mocks show
The whole paragraph in normal weight, like the rest of the body
